summary: Learn advanced fibre optic network design with loss budgets, OTDR planning, and design documentation. Build practical skills in 5 days.
lede: Fibre optic network design helps professionals working with fibre networks turn service requirements into installable, test-ready plans. The course covers route and capacity analysis, topology and hardware selection, fibre-count planning, and optical loss budgets that account for splices and connectors. Learners also practise interpreting OTDR and OLTS results and preparing test plans, acceptance checklists, and handover documentation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with fibre networks and need to produce stronger design decisions, better project documentation, and more defensible implementation plans.
prerequisites: You should have working knowledge of fibre optic fundamentals, basic transmission concepts, connector and splice terminology, and common network topologies. Prior experience in telecom, structured cabling, outside plant, or data centre infrastructure is strongly recommended. No coding is required, but you should be comfortable interpreting design drawings, test results, and simple optical loss calculations.
